description: docs/39 I1 — field-level accuracy of the upload extraction (agents /review, via /review/preview). Each case is a short contract with hand-checked labels for the fields it states; a labelled null means the contract does not state that field and the model must say so. Cases target the known weak spots: day-first and numbers-only dates, the non-renewal vs termination notice split (F1), calendar-month notice, non-USD amounts, amounts in words, initial vs renewal terms, venue vs governing law, signed vs effective dates, and fields a contract leaves out (a percentage share or a price list is no value). Grow to 30–50 cases; every correction users make in the Fields panel is a candidate (docs/39 I2).
